3D floor explorer

Pick any tower and floor

Tap or click a floor in the model, or choose it from the lists, to see that floor’s offices and shops, with sizes, prices and height. Drag to turn the model, pinch or scroll to zoom.

Shilp Centrica: one L-shaped office tower on a corner plot next to the metro in GIFT City’s domestic zone, floor by floor from the plans on Shilp’s website: ten shops on the ground floor and eight on floor 1, offices on floors 2 to 30 (19 per floor on floors 3 to 17, 14 per floor above, where the north-east wing steps back to private terraces), a skip floor at floor 19 and the business centre, gym, cafeteria and terrace gardens on top. Every unit carries the number printed on the plan. Gujarat RERA registers 474 offices and 18 shops; the published plans show 471 offices. Plans are drawn south-up and square to the road on the west side; the tower is placed on the building now under construction (within about 15 m, as tall towers lean in satellite pictures). Floor heights are not published: 3.75 m floor to floor is assumed. Surroundings are from OpenStreetMap.
